PRESIDENT'S ORDER 13 of 1984
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
13 of 1984
HOUSES OF
PARLIAMENT AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (ELECTIONS) (THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1984
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 5th December, 1984]
No. F. 17 (2)/84-Pub.-The
following Order, made by the President, is hereby published for general
information :-
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in execrcise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Order may be called the Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies
(Elections) (Third Amend ment) Order, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article 13, P.
(P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977.---In the Houses of Parliament and Provincial
Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 iP. (P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977], in Article
13, after clause (4), the following new clause shall be added, namely :-
"(5) For
the purpose of an election to fill a casual vacancy, reference in this Article
to the Commission shall be construed as reference to the Commissioner."
